technical.status.http_4xx.title: Client error (HTTP 4xx)
technical.status.http_4xx.why_it_matters: Search engine crawlers and visitors encounter broken pages, degrading user experience and wasting crawl budget.
technical.status.http_4xx.recommended_action: Fix internal broken links pointing to this page or restore the content. If permanently removed, configure a 301 redirect.

technical.status.http_5xx.title: Server error (HTTP 5xx)
technical.status.http_5xx.why_it_matters: Server errors prevent indexing and represent immediate site instability.
technical.status.http_5xx.recommended_action: Investigate application/server logs to identify and resolve backend crashes.

technical.links.broken_internal.title: Broken internal link detected
technical.links.broken_internal.why_it_matters: Broken internal links frustrate users and prevent search engine bots from discovering and indexing valuable pages.
technical.links.broken_internal.recommended_action: Update the href attribute to point to the valid active URL or remove the broken link.

technical.canonical.missing.title: Missing canonical URL tag
technical.canonical.missing.why_it_matters: Without a canonical tag, search engines may index duplicate or parameterized URL variants, diluting ranking signals.
technical.canonical.missing.recommended_action: Add a <link rel="canonical" href="..."> tag to the <head> section referencing the authoritative URL.

technical.canonical.mismatch.title: Canonical URL points to a different address
technical.canonical.mismatch.why_it_matters: The declared canonical points away from this URL. If unintended, this causes the current page to be ignored by search indexes.
technical.canonical.mismatch.recommended_action: Ensure the canonical URL accurately represents the intended authoritative version.

technical.redirect.chain.title: Redirect chain detected
technical.redirect.chain.why_it_matters: Redirect chains add round-trip latency and waste crawler budget.
technical.redirect.chain.recommended_action: Update internal links to target the final destination directly.

technical.robots.missing.title: robots.txt not found
technical.robots.missing.why_it_matters: A missing robots.txt leaves crawler behavior unguided and can cause unintended indexing of private resources.
technical.robots.missing.recommended_action: Create a robots.txt file at the root domain specifying crawl permissions and sitemap locations.

technical.sitemap.missing.title: XML sitemap not detected
technical.sitemap.missing.why_it_matters: XML sitemaps provide search engines with an authoritative roadmap of all indexable pages.
technical.sitemap.missing.recommended_action: Generate an XML sitemap and declare its URL in robots.txt.

technical.security.missing_hsts.title: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header missing
technical.security.missing_hsts.why_it_matters: HSTS enforces HTTPS connections, protecting users against SSL-stripping and man-in-the-middle attacks.
technical.security.missing_hsts.recommended_action: Configure the web server to send 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.

onpage.title.missing.title: Missing <title> tag
onpage.title.missing.why_it_matters: Title tags are one of the strongest on-page ranking signals and define the snippet title in search results.
onpage.title.missing.recommended_action: Add a unique, descriptive <title> tag between 30 and 60 characters.

onpage.title.too_long.title: Title tag exceeds recommended length
onpage.title.too_long.why_it_matters: Titles longer than 60 characters are truncated in search engine result pages (SERPs).
onpage.title.too_long.recommended_action: Shorten the title to under 60 characters while retaining primary keywords.

onpage.description.missing.title: Missing meta description
onpage.description.missing.why_it_matters: Meta descriptions provide searchers with a clear summary and directly impact click-through rates.
onpage.description.missing.recommended_action: Add a compelling <meta name="description" content="..."> between 70 and 160 characters.

onpage.h1.missing.title: Missing <h1> heading
onpage.h1.missing.why_it_matters: H1 tags establish primary topic relevance for users and search algorithms.
onpage.h1.missing.recommended_action: Include exactly one clear and descriptive <h1> heading on the page.

onpage.h1.multiple.title: Multiple <h1> headings found
onpage.h1.multiple.why_it_matters: Multiple H1 tags can dilute topic clarity and confuse screen readers.
onpage.h1.multiple.recommended_action: Retain one primary <h1> and convert secondary headings to <h2>.

onpage.images.missing_alt.title: Image missing alt attribute
onpage.images.missing_alt.why_it_matters: Alt text is required for screen readers and assists search engines in image indexing.
onpage.images.missing_alt.recommended_action: Add an alt attribute describing the image, or alt="" if purely decorative.

geo.llms_txt.missing.title: Missing /llms.txt file
geo.llms_txt.missing.why_it_matters: /llms.txt provides LLM-based crawlers and AI search agents with structured, high-signal markdown summaries of your site.
geo.llms_txt.missing.recommended_action: Create a standardized /llms.txt file outlining core entities, APIs, and key markdown resources.

geo.ai_bots.blocked.title: AI search crawlers blocked in robots.txt
geo.ai_bots.blocked.why_it_matters: Blocking OAI-SearchBot or PerplexityBot prevents your site from appearing as an authoritative source in AI answers.
geo.ai_bots.blocked.recommended_action: Allow search/retrieval bots while disallowing generic training bots if desired.

geo.entity.unstructured.title: Weak entity clarity and lack of structured identity
geo.entity.unstructured.why_it_matters: AI engines rely on clear entity attribution (Organization, Person, Product) to cite authoritative sources.
geo.entity.unstructured.recommended_action: Add structured JSON-LD with valid schema.org types, official names, and sameAs social links.

schema.jsonld.syntax_error.title: Invalid JSON-LD syntax
schema.jsonld.syntax_error.why_it_matters: Malformed JSON-LD cannot be parsed by search engines, nullifying rich snippet opportunities.
schema.jsonld.syntax_error.recommended_action: Correct JSON syntax errors such as trailing commas or unescaped characters.

accessibility.html.missing_lang.title: Missing or empty lang attribute on <html> element
accessibility.html.missing_lang.why_it_matters: Screen readers depend on the lang attribute to pronounce text correctly.
accessibility.html.missing_lang.recommended_action: Add a valid ISO language code to the <html> tag, e.g. <html lang="en">.

accessibility.form.unlabeled_input.title: Form input missing associated label
accessibility.form.unlabeled_input.why_it_matters: Users with assistive technologies cannot determine the purpose of unlabeled form fields.
accessibility.form.unlabeled_input.recommended_action: Associate an explicit <label for="..."> with the input element or provide aria-label.
